plan.goal: Publish two snapshot package repositories and replace their embedded Game.Packages directories with pinned submodules.
acceptance: Change only the two README titles before snapshot publication.
Publish atomic main and annotated 2026.0.1 refs to both empty GitHub repositories without force.
Replace both directories with HTTPS submodules at the published commits and add no branch properties.
Preserve Unity meta policy, root user changes and all unrelated module content.
Pass recursive clone, Unity tests, independent review and Strict lifecycle validation.

execution.handoff: Work only in the isolated publication worktree from exact baseline f19cf152; normalize the two README titles, preserve all other package bytes and replace the directories with the two already-published pinned submodules. The orchestrator alone owns remote publication and root gitlink integration.
validationEvidence: Independent gpt-5.6-sol:high baseline review accepted the refined publication contract.
Both exact GitHub remotes returned zero refs immediately before phase preparation.
